blocks.text: then says (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ) 'Alhamdu Lillaah'), you should reply to his sneeze. You should however not reply to his sneeze, when he does not say (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ) ('Alhamdu Lillaah').' Therefore, when my son sneezed and did not say (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ) ('Alhamdu Lillaah'), I did not reply to his sneeze. On the other hand, when the lady sneezed, she said (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ) ('Alhamdu Lillaah') and replied to her sneeze.' 'You have done well,' my mother nodded in approval.
The Practices of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) in this Regard

Hadhrat Makhool Azdi reports that he was once with Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) in the Masjid when someone sneezed in the corner of the Masjid. To this, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said, "(يَرْحَمُكَ اللّٰهُ) ('Yar-Hamu Kallaah') to you if you have said (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ) ('Alhamdu Lillaah')."[^1]
Hadhrat Naafi narrates that whenever anyone replied to the sneeze of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) by saying '('Yar-Hamu Kallaah')', he would say:

blocks.arabic_text: يَرْحَمُنَا اللّٰهُ وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَغَفَرَ لَنَا وَلَكُمْ
blocks.text: "May Allaah shower us and you with His mercy and may He forgive us and you."[^2]

Hadhrat Naafi also reports that when a man once sneezed in front of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) and said (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ) ('Alhamdu Lillaah'), Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) remarked, "You have acted in a very miserly fashion! Why did you not also sent salutations on Rasulullaah ﷺ (recite Durood) when you said (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ) ('Alhamdu Lillaah')?"[^3]

Hadhrat Dahhaak bin Qais Yashkari says, "When a man once sneezed in front of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) and said (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ) ('Alhamdu Lillaah'), Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) remarked, 'Why did you not complete it by sending salutations to Rasulullaah ﷺ (by reciting Durood and Salaam)?'"[^4]
Hadhrat Abu Jamara narrates that he once heard Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reply to someone's sneeze by saying:

blocks.arabic_text: عَافَانَا اللّٰهُ وَإِيَّاكُمْ مِنَ النَّارِ يَرْحَمُكُمُ اللّٰهُ
blocks.text: "May Allaah shower us and you with His mercy and may He forgive us and you."[^5]
